info.title: Krunker API
info.summary: The Krunker.io developer API, the game's public endpoints and the token bound ones, as krapi wraps them
info.description: Generated from the krapi source and docs. The developer API is the official one from FRVR and needs an API key; the game and token tiers are the endpoints the game itself reads, documented from observation. Full docs: https://github.com/NullDev/krapi

servers.description: developer API and most game endpoints
the old rest api and the ranked api

tags.name: developer/clan
tags.description: GET /api/clan/*: a clan's profile and members

tags.name: developer/events
tags.description: events the key's scopes allow, kept for 30 days; own limit of 6 requests a minute on top of the key's

tags.name: developer/kpd
tags.description: player hacker reports; needs the `kpd` scope on the key

tags.name: developer/leaderboard
tags.description: GET /api/leaderboard/*: the ranked leaderboard per region

tags.name: developer/map
tags.description: GET /api/map/* and /api/maps/*: map details, featured maps and map leaderboards

tags.name: developer/market
tags.description: GET /api/market/*: listings, owners and price history per skin

tags.name: developer/match
tags.description: GET /api/match/*: one ranked match with its participants

tags.name: developer/mods
tags.description: GET /api/mods/*: the mod list and single mods

tags.name: developer/player
tags.description: GET /api/player/*: profile, inventory, listings, ranked matches and posts of a player

tags.name: developer/skins
tags.description: GET /api/skins/*: the skin definitions

tags.name: game/clans
tags.description: GET /clans/*: clan profiles, loot config, motd and the recruitment board

tags.name: game/game
tags.description: the static game data the page loads at start plus the community map and mod records

tags.name: game/items
tags.description: the item page of the social market, by skin index

tags.name: game/leaderboards
tags.description: GET /leaderboards/*: player, clan, raid and KrunkCup boards

tags.name: game/legacy
tags.description: api.krunker.io, the old rest api; only the paths the page calls without a token

tags.name: game/market
tags.description: the market reads that answer without a token; listings, inventory and history need one (token wrapper)

tags.name: game/matchmaker
tags.description: matchmaker.krunker.io, plain json without an envelope; the game polls the list every 60 s

tags.name: game/players
tags.description: GET /players/*: the social profile, search, sales, followers and feed

tags.name: game/shop
tags.description: the shop's catalogue data; the wild offer and every purchase need the player's token

tags.name: game/social
tags.description: the social feed; a player's own posts are players.feed

tags.name: game/turf
tags.description: GET /territorial-wars/*: Turf Wars status, clans, players and leaderboards

tags.name: token/creator
tags.description: what a creator sees of their own maps and studios, plus the clan applications of the player

tags.name: token/market
tags.description: the market behind a login: listings, the player's inventory, sales and history, the black market

tags.name: token/player
tags.description: the token's own account: /player, /account, /email, /discord, /guest

tags.name: token/ranked
tags.description: api.krunker.io behind a token: the ranked system's own api, plain {data} without an error field on success

tags.name: token/shop
tags.description: per player shop state and the player's own custom skins (the editor's /skins)

tags.name: token/staff
tags.description: role gated reads: moderators and kpd reviewers; a normal token gets 403 "insufficient permissions"

tags.name: token/trades
tags.description: player to player trades; creating, accepting and cancelling are writes and stay out

get.description:
GET /api/clan/:clanname

Library: `krunker.clan.profile()`

GET /api/clan/:clanname/members, 10 per page, role then score descending

Library: `krunker.clan.members()`

GET /api/events, oldest first; keep the same filters between calls, `next` also moves past events the filters skipped

Library: `krunker.events.list()`

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: event id cursor, the `next` of the previous page; 0 when omitted

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: only these types; everything the key's scopes allow when omitted

parameters.name: target_type
parameters.description: only events about this kind of target, e.g. "map"

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: only these targets, 100 at most, needs target_type

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: season number, current season when omitted or 0
